routes.name: South Face
routes.overview: The rarely-climbed steep south face rises directly above the East Nooksack Glacier, presenting a much more technical alpine rock and ice route than the standard north face. A serious 12-pitch Grade V climb with poor rock quality and limited protection.
routes.approach: Approach is similar to the Beckey route via Ruth Creek and Price Lake moraine, but instead of ascending toward Price Glacier, traverse to the East Nooksack Glacier. routes.name: North Face / Ruth Glacier
routes.overview: A friendly glaciated peak above Hannegan Pass, Ruth Mountain is one of the more accessible alpine summits in the Mount Baker area and a popular introduction to glacier travel. The north-side Ruth Glacier gives a moderate snow climb with a short scramble to the summit.
routes.approach: From the Hannegan Pass Trailhead (end of FR-32, ~5.3 miles off Mt. Baker Highway/SR 542) follow Hannegan Pass Trail #674 up the Ruth Creek valley.
